item.title: SCP Idea: "Albularyo" (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: An "Albularyo" is a healer that uses unconventional medicinal techniques. But this SCP idea in particular is a lot more different, of course.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: YES

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): The basic SCP article layout.

Elevator Pitch:

  • Nato Caluag is an "albularyo", roughly translates to "witch doctor" in english who can conjure instances of "Engkantos" a Filipino mythological creature capable of applying a "sumpa" or curse.
  • This SCP is contained in a cell where he cannot have access to any object that could possibly have been marked with someone's DNA or even fingerprint. A microphone hidden from this SCP's sight must always be present inside his cell.
  • Moreover, any form of media that could potentially contain piece of a person's identity can never be shown to this SCP.
  • As long as this Albularyo sees a person of interest, obtain a piece of their DNA or even acquire an object with that person's fingerprint, if this SCP is in a hostile mood, he will have a "conversation" with an "Engkanto" who he claims to be his best friend and command it to lay a "sumpa" on the chosen victim. (This is why the microphone is necessary, because he verbally converses out loud.)
  • The random victim will experience immense pain on random parts of the body (chosen by Nato) and orifices of the victim will slowly discharge tadpoles and prematurely born insects.
  • Victims of this SCP can never die from the curse. However, the "sumpa" is able to be cured. Just not in a medical sense.
  • Scientific way of cure like medicine or surgery can NEVER prevent the "sumpa". BUT the only way to cure it is to take the victim to another "albularyo" who can perform the ritual of curse-removal.
  • To avoid this hostile activity, a full rosary and the "divine mercy" ritual must sincerely be recited every 3 in the afternoon. (Priests are usually called to perform the procedure and applied with memetics after)

Central Narrative:
Nato Caluag was considered a vengeful and hateful albularyo. Coincidentally, he was also a powerful one. Able to easily conjure Engkantos (who were actually the enemies of the witch doctors).
In the provinces of The Philippines, albularyos are considered healers and able to remove curses from victims. But Nato was the opposite of this and would apply the curse with the help of his "friend", an "Engkanto" that he met when he was young.
Nato grabbed the attention of the foundation after consecutive cases of unexplainable diseases were reported in the province of Bulacan.
Nato is actually the elder brother of Ed Caluag, a famous paranormal expert in Filipino mainstream media, but when the foundation took him, memetics were given to Ed and his family, completely forgetting his existence.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

  • Explores the pseudo-science belief of Filipino culture, especially the "albularyos" and "engkantos" with a unique take
  • This SCP can talk to engkantos and demand them to apply a curse ("sumpa") on a human, but this will never kill them, only make them suffer. And the only way to cure the curse is to find another albularyo capable of removing the curse.
  • Affiliation with a famous Filipino icon, but since he was taken by the foundation, his existence is not known to the public.

Additional Notes:

  • I'd gladly accept your critique on this and what should be improved.
  • I'd just like to know whether this idea is similar to an already-existing SCP or even tale?

item.title: A lot of buses that are connected(seeking greenlights)
item.description: 194 interconnected buses
item.content:encoded:
page type: an SCP item

narrative: A lot of buses, one for every country, all linked on the inside. It is possible to walk from one to another and they constantly rearrange. Every hour, one of them becomes the main front bus, and begins driving on his own. They have the outside appearance of regular buses, complete with a driver. Some of them have an advertising space on them, that will produce ads for whatever has been inside the bus.

catch: A quick way for the foundation to move around the globe with minimal effort.

item.content:encoded:

Central Narrative: While on its search for methods to erase memories, the CKG Gathering discovers that hitting someone hard enough in the head with a club is able to erase memories. Therefore the club is classified as an anomalous "thing." The Foundation, of course, declares that the record is obsolete since they found a new method of erasing memories; hitting the head with an aluminium bat.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A photo of a club will be added for the readers to instantly notice what the "amnestic" is. Also, there will also be a parody of the amnestics guide page written in cavemen English. After this, I will add a modern revision of the object and will subvert the reader's expectation by revealing the Foundation simply decided to use other tools to bash heads, instead of using amnestics that we know.

Additional Notes: I want to know if there are other articles like this, or if it is better not to link it with SCP-001-EX-J.

item.title: A very long story about a spider and three goons
item.description: An exploration in two layers. On one level, The Chaos Insurgency and what it stands for. On another, loss and how we respond to it.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama action

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: A single spider causes all genetic brain diseases. One woman wants to kill it for taking away her daughter, one man wants to protect it because he wants it to be studied, one girl just wants to be at peace and to succumb to it. An exploration in two layers. On one level, The Chaos Insurgency and what it stands for. On another, loss and how we respond to it.

Central Narrative: Two doctors are employed by The Foundation to research the source of all memory loss and neurodegenerative disease, a big spider. Elizabeth, loses her daughter to a brain disease. Kenneth sees The Foundation using the SCP as a weapon. Elizabeth and Kenneth defect from The Foundation to join the Chaos Insurgency. Now free from direct oversight, Elizabeth decides to kill the spider in revenge. Kenneth wants to capture and study the spider, wanting to prevent The Foundation or other groups from utilizing it for their own ends. Jacquelyn, a student of Elizabeth who was left with The Foundation when Liz defected, half-heartedly pursues the insurgents because she wants to speak with Elizabeth.

What each character represents:
Elizabeth:
- The Insurgency that wants to make the world better with anomalies.
- A self-destructive spite toward the thing that took away her daughter.
- Wins in the end. Destroys the SCP, ridding the world of the force that killed her daughter. To her, the SCP doesn't simply represent neurological diseases. Instead, to Elizabeth - and the audience - it's a stand-in for death.

Kenneth:
- The Insurgency that's simply trying to be a better version of The Foundation.
- A belief that death, even tragic death, is a part of life and should be accepted.
- Ultimately betrayed by Elizabeth and killed while attempting to stop her.

Jacquelyn:
- Simple apathy. The victim of the story, abandoned by Elizabeth and caught in the crossfire.
- Has an opportunity to stop Elizabeth. Doesn't, choosing to simply euthanise herself with happy memories excreted by the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: need help with this one

Additional Notes: Might be too melodramatic of a plot.

elevator pitch: The SCP in question (which I call Black-rock) would be a crystal that looks almost indistinguishable from obsidian in its normal state. item.title: Ever Upwards
item.description: Humanity's desire to escape the atmosphere and explore space has a sinister and unknown motive
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Existential thriller, mystery

Elevator Pitch:
+ Elevator Pitch
- Elevator Pitch

This scp is, in a sense, humanity's seeming desire to leave earth's atmosphere and explore outer space. This scp was discovered once the foundation began to notice strange patterns in the direction and movement of every human and manmade object launched into space, as well as every other object in space (planets, stars, etc), which all appear to be converging to an unknown spot in spacetime at irregular speeds.

Central Narrative:
+ Central Narrative
- Central Narrative

While investigating several other space related anomalies, the foundation begins to put together a strange pattern in the movement of every object that has been launched into space, which all eventually begin to travel in the same exact direction. Digging further, they find a cut section of the Apollo 11 landing, during which mike collins seems to jump and be dragged out in this exact same direction for a few seconds, contrary to the observed gravitational effects of the moon. Curiously, satelites in orbit around earth such as the ISS are unaffected, as well as celestial bodies such as the planets, moons, and sun. However, calculations run by the foundation indicate that these bodies only appear to be unaffected, and have actually been moving in an even pace to one another in this direction for a while. Finally, the foundation uncovers that, over the course of millenia, every object in the universe has been traveling towards a single undefined point in space.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
+ Hook/Attention Grabber
- Hook/Attention Grabber

After running some tests, the foundation manages to calculate the coordinates for this point. After a predictably long journey, they finally manage to send a ship to the coordinates, which finds a barely describable fold in spacetime where all things are seemingly erased. Ordered to return, the unmanned ship curiously defies its controls and moves towards the fold, and strong radio interference is heard as the ship displays a white void. The foundation finds the sounds to be their only lead, and work to decipher a potential meaning. Although they fail, an incident occurs where these sounds are heard again from the sky, this time being mysteriously comprehensible, with the message:
"You have protected your world
from a great many threats,
from those which are incomprehensible,
and for that I am proud.
But what comes now you are not prepared for,
nor am I,
so I must protect you now,
within my unwavering.
Join me,
In this void,
and travel ever upward,
for you have no other choice"

The article ends with a question: If after all the foundation has fought, this void only interferes now, then what exactly is coming for us?

Additional Notes: Hope this isn't too similar to anything else and that it's interesting!

item.title: Individual Rating Modules for Log Entries
item.description: Perhaps an easier way to quality-control.
item.content:encoded:
Low-quality content naturally piles up in places like 682's termination log, 1459's extended logs, and other very large collaborative lists. Inevitably, a page curator has to go through and prune away the bad entries. I imagine that this is tiresome and time-consuming for the curator, and it also means that garbage entries in these logs live much longer than an equally garbage SCP would. If there were some way to install individual rating modules for each item on the log, so they could be voted on individually, then perhaps that might save some time for the curator and shorten the lifespan of the bad entries.

I thought that the log of extranormal events or unexplained locations was already like this, but it seems that I was mistaken.

item.title: Seeking Critique (Love Potion No. 9)
item.description: I thought this would be a good idea for an SCP. Critiques are welcome and necessary :)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy

Elevator Pitch: This is an SCP based upon the narrative created by the song, Love Potion No. 9, made popular by The Clovers in 1959. The premise is that the SCP is the actual love potion described in the song, more or less. The object itself is a safe object, characterized as being an opaque black liquid contained within a small glass bottle. The liquid itself is described as smelling of turpentine. Its anomalous property is that it causes the drinker to lose all romantic and sexual discretion, except for a marked increase in the attractiveness of members of law enforcement.

Central Narrative: This object came to the attention of the Foundation after a young man was arrested and brought to a mental asylum after falling under the effects of the love potion and succeeding in his attempt to passionately kiss a police officer on patrol. The young man informed officials that he was compelled to behave in that manner after drinking a potion, created by a gypsy fortune teller named Madame Ruth in order to cure him of his bad luck with women.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This is an SCP based on a well known piece of pop culture history. I feel like people will find it quite amusing and maybe even humorous.

Additional Notes: I hope you guys see this as a lighthearted, humorous attempt at an SCP article.

item.title: ClicheFinder™
item.description: Finds cliches and gives owie effect. [thread locked, overflow]
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article (ACS)

Genre: meta

Elevator Pitch:

An unbranded notebook. When a description, name, or information is written on the 57th page of the notebook, the notebook then proceeds to display the "cliche-ness" of such information. The basing of this "cliche-ness" is unknown, and no reasonable pattern has been reported". Guidelines if whether the subjects is a cliche:

  • If the subject is a person, the said subject would then lose consciousness for approximately 3 hours and 34 minutes. After this effect, the subject loses all memories of the incident.
  • If the subject is an object (or tangible principle), the subject would then disappear from reality from the range of 0.23 seconds to 246 days. The object would then seemed to have aged 34 years whether it disappeared for any of the specified range of time.
+ show block
– hide block
  • If the subject is a description, the notebook would then identify the described object and classify it to its "cliche-ness". The object would have an effect similar to that of the previous.
  • If the subject is a name for a process, protocol, or any executable procedure, the said subject would then be ignored for 2 hours, to 508 days. This is to NOT be attempted, for any foundation protocol or procedure is to be kept ongoing for eternity.
  • If the subject is a natural law or simply an "unchangeable principle", the subject would experience no other effects that would commence.

Note: If the subject is an extreme cliche, the effects amplify.
LOG:

  • Class-D wrote himself on the paper, the subject was deemed "rare" and no other effect commenced.
  • Class-D wrote his mother's name, notebook deemed subject as "moderate". Class-D was confused by this and demanded answers.
  • Researcher wrote "Dr. Bright" on paper, the subject was deemed cliche, Dr. Bright suffered the loss of consciousness and does not remember of this experience. Researcher apprehended.
  • Researcher wrote "gravity", no other effect.
  • Researcher entered "Procedure 110-Montauk" on the page, [DATA EXPUNGED] and researcher was demoted to Class-D.

Central narrative:
Just some logs on the SCP, the usual SCP logging of course, along with some interviews with affected persons.

Hook/ Attention Grabber:

A lot of logs regarding the SCP, all effects. Also, this SCP is meta considering that the "cliche-ness" of the subjects is based on how common their appearances are in our writing.

Additional Notes:

got this idea from reading a ton of SCP's and got pissed from the cliches. Pls no cliche

item.title: New SCP Concept- first time author
item.description: This SCP is a man who imbue torture devices with anomalous effects
item.content:encoded:
This SCP is a man who imbue torture devices with anomalous effects using very specific ingredients. He is presumed to have existed since at least the peak of the Ancient Egyptian empire.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Essentially my concept for an SCP is the above summary, with a document listing a few (not to many don’t worry, it isn’t just an item list facade) of the anomalous devices he is believed to have created. It also features a log of an exploration into a tomb that featured hieroglyphics depicting the man’s anomalous abilities in action. A photograph of him was also discovered, but the church the photograph was located in had been destroyed, and the town soon became suspicious of the foundation agents. The addendum features a mildly successful attempt he made to steal an artifact prior to the foundation’s full understanding of his abilities.

item.title: A Complete Group
item.description: (Requesting Greenlights) Selflessness can only go so far.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A total of 49 tombs(and one vacant tomb) located underground. The bodies belonged to a group of reality benders who could 'bless' (call it what you will) chosen areas and prevent anyone within those areas from ever getting injured or killed. As of now,their corpses now 'curse' people within 20 meters of them. It was something not even they knew the reason for.

Central Narrative: The story will begin with the only known survivor of the group being discovered and interviewed in the former headquarters of the group. The survivor explains that over 23 years,they have researched and logged all areas affected by their 'blessings' in order to see where the best places to bless would be.

He further explains that the reason they have all passed away was due to the leader.(Who he refers to as "The Willow") Her death caused a chain reaction upon all the members of the group to perish,leaving only the unnamed survivor to bury them.

Hook: If you enjoy stories about the history of abandoned places,this could definitely intrigue you if I do it right. In the end,its a simple story about the past of a group of people.

Additional Notes:
•The article will include the logs and research created by their group
•In the article,the survivor will state that his curse was the inability to leave the Headquarters and the tombs.He states that "the others were not so lucky."

•If there is anything that seems off,please tell me.

item.title: The innate nature of things.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP is an Extradimensional space (hereafter referred to as ES). ES exists as a parallel dimension to our own. ES is filled with esoteric machines that continuously enforce the physical logical and thaumaturgic laws of reality.

Central Narrative: foundation discovers common abstract mechanism enabling magic. Through prodding it manage to open a door to ES. Finds machines and fucks with them discovering that they sustain the laws of the universe. ES has a layered structure and foundation goes deeper uncovering larger machines responsible for more significant laws. Security is tight and progress becomes harder as they get further in. As the foundation make progress, they learn that our universe is built of the foundation of one that came before. Nothing about this prior universe will ever make sense to us because it does not use any of the laws we use. The old universe ended because of a great machine that destroyed it while building another. The first great reveal is that said machine is the SCP.

+ show block
– hide block

The foundation find that some of the machines seem to have no effect on enforcing universal laws. A brave researcher fucks with one without permission and causes it to output a huge mass of metal. Analysis of this metal reveals some haphazard data encoded within. Foundation works out that the machine is trying to deliver a message. estimates that as much as 70% of the machine is dedicated to nothing more than composing and outputting a message. They integrate mechanical typewriters into parts of the machine and try and teach it English. After a very long time they get something coherent. The message simply reads.

“this is our gift to you.”

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Every law we know of both physical, logical and thaumaturgical is not innate and is instead enforced upon reality by a machine that you can physically touch. Where did the machines come from and what would happen if they were switched off?

Additional Notes:

I’m not 100% sure about all of the narrative beats here but this is the fundamental idea that I want to write. There are some fun bits that could be thrown in like logs from the foundation testing on the machines. More about the machine’s relationship with the forces of thaumaturgy could be explored.

item.title: Lightspeed shoes
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Science Fiction/Action

Page Layout (Optional): standard format with threat level, object class, description and containment procedures followed by an addendum or two going over the destruction caused by misuse of the SCP before its discovery and maybe some tests to determine its volatile nature

Elevator Pitch: A pair of brand-name running shoes which exponentially accelerate its wearer's speed based on the length of their stride, with strides 45 centimeters or longer plateauing at 99.9% c, due to the fact that no object with matter can achieve light speed.

Understandably, following the laws of physics, this would mean anyone wearing these shoes and attempting to walk would be sent flying at unimaginable speeds while destroying any object in their path while also igniting themselves and a good deal of their surroundings from the massive friction.

Central Narrative: thinking maybe that the shoes were supposedly a part of a complete outfit/tracksuit before the shoes were sold off to unknowing consumers who accidentally triggered its anomalous property and caused enough damage to get the foundation involved. Either that or a GOI or POI's creation that they sold off with the same results

Hook/Attention-Grabber: a very straightforward world-ending safe-class anomaly that somehow follows and breaks the laws of physics through its free rein over the relationship of acceleration, velocity and mass, waiting for one negligent person to slip up and destroy everything in an instant.

Additional Notes: I personally hold more favor for the central narrative that the shoes are possibly part of a whole outfit of anomalous clothing, but feel that the GOI/POI origin would make a much more solid foundation to build from, thinking maybe either a discontinued product of "the factory" or GAW

item.title: 500 grains of people (seeking greenlights)
item.description: Basically 500 people from the future got turned into grains of sand
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Elevator Pitch: SCP-X is the collective term for 500 sapient grains of sand, which all spontaneously appeared in Memphis Tennessee. They don't need to eat or drink, but they do sleep. They move around by sliding around, via anomalous means. They can all talk, but don't have any mouths, or facial features. They're all as audible as normal human beings, and are able to be killed easily, such as by stomping, throwing, etc.

+ Central Narrative
- Hide

The Foundation first acquires SCP-X when reports of screams in Memphis Tennessee, coming from nowhere start coming in. The Foundation investigates, and soon find the source, approximately 500 grains of sand. They take them to a site, and get the instances to pick one grain to explain what's going on.

The grain explains that they're from the year 2025, and during that year, several ginormous extraterrestrial space crafts landed on earth, and started killing every human they could find. Not animals, they left horses, dogs, everything else alone. They didn't offer surrender to the humans either.

When cities were clear of humans, the aliens started moving in to the houses, and started taking on the humans lives. Except they lacked all the problems that humans had. There weren't wars between them, they were eco friendly, using resources such as solar panels and energy supplies they had brought to earth from their ships. (The grain of sand knows this because he used to be a part of a group of humans who snuck into cities and tried to reclaim them.)

The aliens also seemed to have highly advanced technology, such as weapons that could freeze people in place, and even time machines. Eventually, almost the entire human population was wiped out. And soon the aliens began hording the last humans into chamber, where they were either vaporized, or transformed into other entities, such as animals, or plants, and even furniture. The grain of sand (who was a human at the time) was horded into a large chamber with around 500 other people. The SCP-X instance realized that the aliens operating the machine appeared to be panicking, and the machine malfunctioned, turning the 500 people into grains of sand instead of animals or furniture. It then started a countdown, and apparently went into a kind of "time travel mode", and sent them into the past.

The grains of sand all show signs of traumatization, reasonably. The file is then updated in February of 2025, stating that several ginormous extraterrestrial space crafts appeared out of a wormhole in the Earths solar system. Using information gathered from the SCP-X instances, the Foundation neutralizes the threat.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think the attention grabber here is the end of the world vibe the story brings about, and how there were so little survivors.

Additional Notes: This is a little idea I came up with, let me know what you think of it, I'm open to all criticism and am looking to improve!

item.title: A Actual "Pea" Shooter
item.description: An newbie joins GAW. Newbie creates something to get the gratification of his peers, doesn't go well as he hoped.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy

Elevator Pitch: Guy who recently joined GAW creates an anomaly for his peers for gratification, he doesn't get it and he chastised for the anomaly.

Central Narrative: A new user joins GAW and is excited about the prospect so much he creates an anomaly get laughs and gratification from his peers. The anomaly is an amalgamation of different plant parts stitched together into the rough shape of an gun.

A vine with the back end of it curved into the spiral is the stock, a leaf clover is the trigger, the head of a Venus fly trap acts as placing ammo, a tree branch is the handguard, and a rose acts as the muzzle.

There is a specialized part that is near the Venus head, an enlarged mutated pea pod. Whenever water is poured into the mouth of the Venus head, the pod undergoes production of enlarged peas in the sack. The juices in the sack freeze the peas and they are pushed up into the chamber. Methane gases produced by manure inside the chamber ignite and propel the peas through the flower. These peas can cause damage similar to an actual bullet.

+ show block
– hide block

The newbie made this as an play on the word "Peashooter" as a joke and thought he would get a laugh from the users of GAW. Instead, they find it to be confusing, cringey, and in poor tastes. One user mentions that since it has to potential to hurt people, it counts as a lethal weapon, which goes against their rules. The Newbie profusely apologizes and promises to do better next time. The Foundation found this scp in the trash bin by an internet café.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I structured the scp this way to showcase another side of GAW, for anomalies that don't hit the mark of their liking. The whole "meat" of the article is a chat log recovered shortly after the Foundation discovers the SCP.

Additional Notes: Like I mentioned I don't plan on this scp being deep lore-wise, just want to show another aspect of GAW. What I want to know if this concept work fine as it is or if there are changes and fine-tuning that needs to be made.

item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Elevator Pitch: A fuchsia humanoid about 3 m high, which possesses unproportionally big metallic fists integrated in its body. These fists can punch at a speed of 5000 km/h applying 732.16 gigatons of force. By punching repeatedly, it is capable of destroying solid matter up to the atomical level with enough attacks.

If any type of solid mass comes in contact with the SCP, it will sense the matter and disintegrate it completely until it doesn't sense any more solid mass. If there's no contact with solid matter it will “deactivate” and enter into a fetal position, darkening its color.

This SCP is blind but sound waves will attract the creature. It has an audible range of 30kHz, higher than any human. However it will ignore any sound or contact coming from any other non-solid element.

It has a higher density than water despite the metallic fists and its size, because of this, it stays at the surface of a liquid environment. It is suggested that his body may be made from an extremely compressed gas.

Due to this nature, if it came in contact with the geosphere, it would completely destroy the Earth's mass, ending in an XK End of the World Scenario, which is why it is classified as Keter.

Show
Hide

Central Narrative: In the North Sea of Norway, there have been instances of disappearing boats. Once, a marine returned and described a humanoid rock which obliterated their whole navy by punching.
Once the government of Norway gave permission, the foundation inspected the SCP, causing many losses upon arriving. Luckily, a team inspected the creature from further distance and proceeded various testings to understand the creature's nature.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The most interesting part of this SCP is the seemingly impossible way to contain it.
Any and all attempts of containing it, have failed, due to the lack of mobility of the creature or the impossible silent during the construction of a containment cell within it. The SCP must stay in a liquid body and never to be contained near the geosphere.

Continued 
hope you are having a good day

Learning about the foundation and the reality of working there, having to do tasks such as collecting bodies and using a scanner to DNA identify their limbs to make sure all confirmed deaths are accounted for and throwing any loose “Scraps” of flesh and organs into a barrel of acid gil calls the “Stew.”

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A team of janitors are tasked with cleaning up the messes that other MTF cause all the time without consideration.

item.title: Woodbones
item.description: A creature seeking out the frail and weak.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: History

Page Layout: The layout will consist of an interview with Naim to explain his life living with the SCP. It will also include local Ptichar news stories about a teen's incredible strength as well as first hand accounts of people who saw changes in Naim in childhood and of individuals attending events during his time in the Olympics (possibly Olympic footage depending on copyright). Also included will be an autopsy report of Naim after his death allowing inference of the SCP's current whereabouts and it's life cycle.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a long, skinny branch-like creature with a conscious. It is able to bend, break, and mend its body to create shapes. SCP-XXXX was first recorded hiding among trees in a forest outside the town of Ptichar, Bulgaria. The creature lurks in forests and attempts of make contact with children aged 6-12 years old. SCP-XXXX will approach selected targets and reach out one of it's appendages. If the child refuses contact, SCP-XXXX moves on to a new target. If the target "accepts SCP-XXXX's invitation", SCP-XXXX will begin to fold upon itself and burrow its thin body into the skin of the target. Once inside, SCP-XXXX begins to replace the spinal chord and bones of the target.

Central Narrative: The story will follow Naim Suleymanoglu, a Bulgarian weightlifter, who was affected by SCP-XXXX. Naim's story will follow his path from a child meeting SCP-XXXX to an Olympic champion. His family and friends are in shock by Naim's spontaneous strength and with such incredible feats, the world began to notice. With such fame at such a young age, the spotlight is on him for most of his life, and for outside perspectives of Naim, things are not as they may seem to him. He himself sees a physical change while others see something much deeper. The SCP researchers (and the reader) are in a constant battle about whether this SCP is actually what Naim believes it to be.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Beyond Naim explaining his life and the effects of the SCP, news reports, olympic footage, and first hand accounts will contrast what Naim believes to be a friend and blessing, and show the SCP for what it truly is. These outside perspectives will be periodically contrasted to Naim's experiences and leave the reader to decide the true desires and motives of the SCP and whether it is truly good or evil.

Additional Notes: Naim Suleymanoglu is a real man who stood at 4' 11'' weighing 137 lbs who managed, despite his size, to break many world records in weight lifting. There are specifics I have planned out for his story that I couldn't fit into the word count so please ask if any interest you!

It’s intelligent and calls himself “The Comedian”, and those who don’t laugh at his jokes he will remove his mask revealing a Venus fly trap shaped head and will bite the person’s head off who didn’t laugh. When asked about these incidents he will say that he doesn’t recall doing those kinds of acts.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: In order to keep this SCP from going on a killing spree, the foundation has made its containment cell a small comedy club theater and will have D-Class as its audience. Outside it’s cell it says everyone who enters must laugh at any joke no matter how terrible it is.

Additional Notes: I would like feedback on containment procedures and tone of the document.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): SCP

Elevator Pitch: When interacted with or viewed with any of the 5 senses, the victim's body will emit high amounts of radiation and begin to dismember in chunks and reassemble on a molecular level. The victim remains alive during this and after 5 minutes, the victim ejects towards the sun and causes a solar event. The state of those who end up being ripped apart is "contagious" and spreads to surrounding organisms.

Central Narrative: An orb of self contained gamma radiation was secured at Chernobyl's nuclear power plant, underneath reactor 4. Its properties are highly lethal and apocalyptic. SCP-XXXX is stored in a hollow lead sphere with a tungsten exterior shell with electrical probes that relay data in numerical form to prevent personnel from interacting with SCP-XXXX directly.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The origin of SCP XXXX is via Chernobyl's infamous "Elephant's Foot" or Corium deposit has melted through the basin of of the nuclear power plant and reached a water source, causing an explosion. Anomalous activity was reported to the foundation shortly after a disaster recovery team was assigned to investigate.

Additional Notes: I have the scp's sort of framework done and its ready for more lore which I am open to suggestions for. This is my first attempt at writing an scp and I am not familiar with too many of them so if there is already an article on a similar idea, my apologies.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight for my SCP idea :)

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): I, really don't know.

Elevator Pitch: An SCP that can burn anything other than steel. It looks like a plastic toy campfire. Anything else it can burn with ease, even materials with more resistance to heat than steel. It has been shown to kill humans very quickly.

Central Narrative: This anomaly is an object that resembles a plastic toy campfire. It is an object that burn anything that isn't steel within a few seconds. Materials that have more resistance to heat than steel will still burn. Even containing it in it's own ashes won't work because it will burn away the ash leaving a slightly smaller layer of ash beneath it.
It was recovered when locals spotted an unnaturally formed cave as if an object had burned what was underneath it to create the hole, with wildfires being reported at the same time, the foundation decided to look into it, and found this.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: It's an SCP that could burn down a whole forest, yet easily contained. In other words it can deal massive damage yet can be kept safe from the world. That's a weird thought.
Additional Notes: I really want advice on whether to keep or trash the recovery logs.

item.title: Time Distorting Shower
item.description: First attempt creating an SCP.
item.content:encoded:
Good evening,

this is my first attempt creating an SCP.
I am looking forward to your feedback.

~Florian

EDIT: Thank you Truc Linh, I've change the style.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mystical

Page Layout: In descending order: Containment Procedures, Description, Addenda & Experiments, Summary. Information is thought to be layered, meaning that the more you read, the more background information you get. It won't be necessary to read the addenda and experiments, but it will certainly give the reader a better understanding of what they are dealing with.

Elevator Pitch: This SCP represents a shower that is able to distort the time for individuals inside the cabin.

Central Narrative:

  • SCP came to the attention of the foundation when a field agent, working in a hospital, recieves a call from a person saying that he does not age
  • Investigation is initiated and the SCP is recovered.
  • A bunch of experiments are conducted to understand how exactly the SCP manages to distort time (Class D Personnel is sent into the cabin under different circumstances)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The time distortion is based on the thoughts and emotions of the subject showerig. If a subject is completely aware of the situation and focuses on the time, nothing will happen. Furthermore, the capabilities of the SCP are not yet fully understood, and the mind of the reader should be stimulated to come up with their own experiements - What would they do? What experiments are possible?

Additional Notes: The article is already written - if you want the full version, just let me know.

item.title: The Voodoo Wiimote
item.description: The fun goes far beyond the game itself.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A Nintendo Wii remote which acts as a voodoo doll on whomever or whatever its user is thinking about, so long as:

  • The Wii console the remote is paired to is powered on.
  • The remote is not connected to a Nunchuk peripheral.
  • The remote’s batteries are at least half full.

Central Narrative: A Nintendo Wii console was hooked up to a break room TV at Site-23. Almost immediately after, a researcher suffered severe injuries when one of the console’s remotes was sent flying into the TV. A security officer ordered for the console to be removed and disposed of, but submitted the previously mentioned remote to the labs for research. Soon after this, the object was registered as an SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Wii remote is mysterious in that there is very little potential for explaining its anomalous properties, and that it has potential use to the Foundation as a means of keeping peace at its sites.

Additional Notes: I wasn’t able to find any SCPs similar to this concept, so I was hoping critics could let me know if there are.

item.title: The Technician's Glasses
item.description: Anti-memetic glasses that explain the SCP universe's interaction with the law of conservation of mass
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: When worn, you are put in an anti-memetic state and, when viewing any anomaly that seemingly creates matter or energy, you will see a rubber wire leading out of it and into the sky.

Central Narrative: The foundation interacts with the 'electricity' that comes from these wires, until eventually they receive an invoice from the 'Electric Company' advising them to cease experimentation. They are successful in the creation of numerous useful anomalous devices before eventually, a 'Technician' appears in the site and retrieves the glasses before amnesticizing the foundation staff and deleting the file, which is found in data-backlogs by MTF-Rho 9. The item is considered neutralized for the time being.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The file is seemingly still anti-memetic and one needs to be conditioned using memetic images to view it. The underlying narrative of a foundation existing above the foundation responsible for the empowering of Anomalous items is the main hook of the article. Another piece of the puzzle is added to the mystery of where the energy for anomalies come from, with more room for expansion.

item.title: SCP IN NEED OF GREENLIGHT!!! LIFE GIVING PARASITE
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: The scp is a life giving parasite that infect inanimate objects and gives them vital organs and personalities. These instances usually become suicidal and begin to ponder on why they were given life. All instances that the foundation has encountered have been friendly and interactive. as If they were human. The foundation contains them by putting them in separate decompression tanks. They have monitors on the side that keep track of their vital signs. The foundation also keeps track of the lifespan of the infected instances. On one occasion, a parasite left the object. That object: (a toothbrush) was able to continue functioning as a regular tooth brush.

Central Narrative: It is a parasite that gives every day objects the ability to live.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The origin of the parasites are unknown. There are currently 110 encounters on the foundation record.

A humanoid entity with a slight narcissistic attitude paired with an ability to mess with minds. (Seeking critique, as this will be my first idea on the site)

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This SCP is a humanoid entity with an unspecified or no gender, this SCP has its own anomalous property that make others 'listen' to it in a way. With its inhuman looks and narcissistic personality it caused a few problems…

Central Narrative: When a staff member found this SCP roaming the streets it was shouting at someone and then killed that someone while showing itself under the hood. Only to be caught detained shortly after by the staff member who was watching this unfold. It is now being held and contained, but makes trouble about being perfect and such often. Not much is known about the SCP, except for things like its ability to 'trick' the human mind, but it is thought to be from another place, planet, or possibly even universe, the Foundation cannot specify except the fact that it knows what it is, and possibly where it is from. Yet it will not comply or tell them either, as this was tried and failed.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP can use its words to make people listen to it, it can somehow make people listen when it brings up something that a person wants, and tells them (The person) what to do to get it, making them do something that them in their right mind wouldn't, like going closer to said SCP. The effect that it gives needs to be tested on a bit more, as the Foundation doesn't know if it is explainable scientifically as of yet. The ability, or anomalous effect, the SCP has is connected to its nickname and personality, since it has slightly hinted at it, as those who are perfect do not have greed or something they want, this SCP may 'want' something but it does not think like that, it thinks that it can get it because it is perfect. And if the anomalous effect is connected, that means it has no sins or anything imperfect, from its point of view, maybe meaning if you do something that counts as bad or imperfect, also in its point of view, it may be able to get into your head.

Additional Notes: I'm not good at explaining ability's or anything of the sort, and this is my first ever SCP idea I'm putting here, so I would like good feedback on what I should change, or a different thing I should do.
